message: Just received my bill from T-NETIX. I was not required as others have been to sign-up or give a credit check, thank goodness. My complaint is that the recording when I receive the call says that the billing fee is $1.50. They even went so far as to call me and confirm that the fee was $1.50.  When the bill came it was $2.49.  When I called I was told that the fee had gone up at the first of the year from $1.95 to $2.49.  I once again told the person that the recording said $1.50.  She confirmed that $2.49 was correct, I asked for an adjustment and was told someone would contact me. I will keep you all posted.  If I don't receive help I will also file a complaint with my PUC and the FCC and I believe that the FTC should also become involved.  I also emailed the sheriff in the county involved, asking if law enforcement really wanted to be involved in this robbery scam and asked if they would investigate the fradulent statement coming from their facility.
